chunks: And from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah, Exalted and Mighty, has a Paradise that He has stored away for three: a just leader, a man who allows his Muslim brother to share in his wealth, and a man who goes out to help his Muslim brother in a need, whether it is fulfilled for him or not.

key_terms.يَحْكُمُ أَخَاهُ فِي مَالِهِ: Allows his brother to share in his wealth
key_terms.يَمْشِي فِي حَاجَةٍ: Goes out to help in a need

ai.seo_question: Who are the three people for whom Allah has reserved a special Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kitab al-Mumin* highlights the triad of spiritual excellence by linking political justice, financial generosity, and active social service. It underscores the Shia emphasis on the Imam as the ideal just leader while elevating the status of ordinary believers who actively facilitate the needs of others, reflecting the concept of *ta'awun* (cooperation in righteousness).
